cards.back: Drop any .json file into this app's flashcards folder. It loads without a restart.

cards.front: What does a deck file look like?
What happens to a card you mark Failed?
cards.back: It counts as Again and comes back after a short step, once other cards have had their turn.

cards.front: What happens if you respawn mid-card?
cards.back: Nothing is lost and nothing is graded. The same card comes back in the same state on your next death.
